model.name: Luo2022 - iLJ1162-genome-scale metabolic network Shewanella oneidensis MR-1

body.p: The model iLJ1162 , comprised 1162 genes, 1818 metabolites and 2084 reactions, can accurately predict cellular growth using a variety of substrates with a 86.9% identity with experiment results, which is significantly higher than 62.3% and 61.9% simulated by previous published model iMR1_799 and iSO783.
